title: Roots of polynomials over semirings and hyperfields
summary: We continue our investigation of roots of polynomials over semirings and hyperfields, employing a property on semiring and hyperfield ``pairs'' with a surpassing relation $\preceq,$ which we call $\preceq$-reversibility. There are two kinds of roots generalizing the classical algebraic theory, ``null roots,'' and $\preceq$-roots. The theory works best when all null roots are also $\preceq$-roots.
